ra: The thetan is a core belief-entity of the Scientology cosmological framework.
Body thetans are part of the OT-level Scientology cosmology.
Xenu belongs to the OT III cosmogony within Scientology cosmology.
The Marcab Confederacy is part of the galactic-civilization cosmology of Scientology.
Body thetans are, in OT III belief, disembodied thetans of the same essential nature as the personal thetan.
In the Incident II account, body thetans originate from the disembodied beings Xenu is said to have brought to Earth.

Scientology's galactic past-life cosmology (interstellar civilizations, thetans from elsewhere in the galaxy) shares the modern UFO-religion/galactic-origin motif expressed in the contemporary Starseed belief; a functional modern alignment, not identity.
